hook.name: LendingHookV4
hook.description: A hook-based lending AMM where LPs deposit ETH and TOKEN into a full-range Uniswap v4 position and borrowers lock TOKEN collateral to receive ETH at 40% LTV with interest accrual. Includes permissionless liquidations, protocol swap fee skimming via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and sandwich-defense price snapshots that block borrows and swaps in the same block as a liquidation.
